author: TkDodo
assessment: Only query-core source changes: the private shouldScheduleTimer helper rejects disabled observers, server environments, and invalid timeouts; stale/refetch scheduling both use it. The new disabled-observer test covers the stale-timeout regression; the existing query observer and wider core suites pass with Istanbul instrumentation.
limitations: Checks confirm this changed package; they do not assert every reverse dependent has a clean independent suite.
Offline dependency audit is excluded; no vulnerability-free claim.
